name: SRY-box transcription factor 2

function.text: SOX2 encodes transcription factor SOX-2. Annotated molecular activities include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and DNA-binding transcription activator activity, RNA polymerase II-specific. It participates in chromatin organization and regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to anophthalmia/microphthalmia-esophageal atresia syndrome (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Lung squamous cell carcinoma; Esophageal squamous cell carcinoma. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from Illumina. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.
